_comment: Post-merge cherry-pick offer. Posted by process_merge_queue._offer_cherrypick() right after the merged notice, when at least one active release branch was discovered. The token->branch mapping is generated per topic (active branches move as new rc branches are cut), so BRANCH_LINES is the authoritative mapping the approver answers against. See DESIGN section 1.24.
_usage: Vars: TICKET_ID, APPROVER_ID (the cherry-pick decider — REVIEW_BOT_CHERRYPICK_DECIDER_OPEN_ID, falling back to the primary approver; any approver may still answer), BRANCH_LINES (array placeholder - one paragraph per offered branch, built by _offer_cherrypick). The topic stays out of closed/ while review.cherrypick_window_until is in the future; the dispatcher archives it on expiry.

content.text: 需要 cherry-pick 到发布分支吗？当前活跃分支：
